title: Mega AI Pricing 2026: What It Costs and Why There Is No Price List
summary: Mega AI (gomega.ai) pricing for 2026: Starter, Grow and Grow Faster, what each plan includes, why paid ads need the top plan, and what to ask on the sales call.
body_markdown:
## The short answer


- **Mega AI publishes no prices.** Its three plans, Starter, Grow and Grow Faster, are each quoted on a sales call.
- What changes between plans is which of its four agents you get. Paid ads are only in Grow Faster, the top plan.
- No trial is listed. Ask for the monthly price, setup fee, contract length and cancellation terms in writing before you sign.
- For comparison, Sprites Build is $29 to $99 a month with paid ads, SEO and AI visibility, and starts with a 7-day trial for $1.


Plans as listed on gomega.ai/pricing on November 21, 2026.


## Mega AI plans


Plan Agents included Price


Starter Website, SEO and GEO Quoted on a call


Grow SEO and GEO, Conversion, Website Quoted on a call


Grow Faster All four: SEO and GEO, Paid Ads, Conversion, Website Quoted on a call


Mega describes Starter as launching a high-converting website and getting found in search and AI answers, Grow as building visibility and converting every lead, and Grow Faster as the complete growth engine with paid acquisition.


## Why there is no price list


Mega does not explain it on the page. The pattern is common for done-for-you packages: the quote depends on your business, the agents you choose and how much setup the website and lead handling need. The cost to you is that you cannot compare Mega with another tool, or rule it out, without a call.


## What to ask on the call


- The monthly price for the plan you need, and whether there is a setup fee.
- The contract length, and how you cancel.
- Whether there is a refund if work is not delivered, and what is delivered in the first 30 days.
- Which ad platforms the Paid Ads agent runs, and whether you need Grow Faster to get them.
- Who owns the website and the content if you leave.


## Mega AI vs Sprites on price


Sprites publishes its price and starts the same day. Build is $29 to $99 a month, depending on your business, and covers paid ads, SEO and AI visibility in one plan. Launch is $300 to $500 a month for bigger businesses with more business profiles and seats, and larger companies get a custom plan. Every plan starts with a 7-day trial for $1, and every change to an ad account or a page waits for your approval.


Mega is ahead on two things Sprites does not do: an AI front desk that answers calls and books leads, and building a new website. If those are what you need, the call may be worth it. If your customers come from paid ads and search, compare the two on[Sprites vs Mega AI](https://www.sprites.ai/compare/gomega) , read the full[Mega AI review](https://www.sprites.ai/blog/gomega-ai-review) , or see how[Ryze AI pricing](https://www.sprites.ai/blog/ryze-ai-pricing) splits ads and SEO into two plans. Sprites plans are on the[pricing page](https://www.sprites.ai/pricing) .


## Mega AI pricing questions


### How much does Mega AI cost per month?


Mega AI does not publish a monthly price. Its pricing page lists Starter, Grow and Grow Faster, and each plan is quoted after you schedule a call.


### What is included in each Mega AI plan?


Starter includes the Website agent and the SEO and GEO agent. Grow includes the SEO and GEO, Conversion and Website agents. Grow Faster includes all four agents, adding Paid Ads.


### Which Mega AI plan includes paid ads?


Only Grow Faster. The Paid Ads agent, which runs Google and Meta campaigns, is not in Starter or Grow.


### Does Mega AI have a free trial?


Mega AI lists no trial on its pricing page; each plan starts with a sales call.


### Why does Mega AI not publish prices?


Mega does not say. Packages quoted on a call usually vary with the business, the agents chosen and the setup work, which also makes them hard to compare. Ask for the monthly price, any setup fee, the contract length and the cancellation terms in writing.


### What does Sprites cost compared with Mega AI?


Sprites publishes its price. Build is $29 to $99 a month, depending on your business, and includes paid ads, SEO and AI visibility. Launch is $300 to $500 a month for bigger businesses with more profiles and seats, larger companies get a custom plan, and every plan starts with a 7-day trial for $1.
